commons-exports-check.desc: Checks the root `mod.rs` of every `t/` and `s/` commons directory. Every module declared in the root `mod.rs` must be private (i.e. `mod x;`, never `pub mod x;`) and must be glob re-exported by a `pub use x::*;` in that same `mod.rs`. The glob re-export is not required when the module exposes no public items to re-export (e.g. a module containing only `impl` blocks).
